t: You're looking at Percy Circus, a ring of townhouses around a central garden in Clerkenwell, where Great Percy Street meets Vernon Street. The name comes from Robert Percy Smith, known as Bobus, a lawyer and Member of Parliament who also served as Judge Advocate-General of Bengal in India. So the circus carries the name of a man whose career stretched from Westminster to British India. Take a moment to look at how the houses curve around the garden in the middle.
